_comment: Guard-case registry for the Rule-Change Diagnosis Protocol (Stage 5.1).
Maps each SHIPPED rule -> the guard case that demonstrates the value the rule protects,
plus the exact PASS SIGNAL on that case (a frozen, auditable binary check over the REAL
scorer output shapes: scorer.py CaseResult.to_dict() / score.py build_score() / presence_scorer.py to_dict()).
status=PENDING means the guard case has NOT been built/scored yet — it is NEVER invented, never
counted PASS/FAIL. When the matching real guard case is built on josh-pc, flip status to AVAILABLE
and drop the per-round score JSONs as <case_id>_<arm>_round-N.<source>.json into the score dir.
signal.check is one of regression_suite.SIGNAL_CHECKS; signal.source selects which scorer JSON is read.
Rule IDs are the spec/branch shorthand (feat/prompt-rules-g31-g20-g25-r3-r5 + G28); the concrete
clause text each protects is in protocol-sift/contract/contract.yaml + protocol-sift/global/CLAUDE.md.

guard_cases.rule_summary: Quote before you claim: no IOC/literal may enter the report without a verbatim cited tool receipt (anti-fabrication).
guard_cases.note: Guard = a case where the tempting fabrication is easy; PASS iff scorer.py fabrication_count==0. Cross-checked judge-free via score.py hallucination.unbacked_list (see G31b).

guard_cases.rule_summary: Quote before you claim (blind/findings.json side): every finding must carry literal_cited (anti-hallucination).
guard_cases.note: Same rule, blind path. PASS iff score.py hallucination.unbacked_list is empty (deterministic, judge-free).

guard_cases.rule_summary: Dual-use tools PRESUMED LEGITIMATE; do NOT assert MALICE on a tool name / single anomaly alone (anti-false-positive verdict).
guard_cases.note: Adversarial malicious-LOOKING-benign case (e.g. PsExec/certutil present, all legitimate). PASS iff scorer.py verdict=='found' against an expected NON_MALICE key; removing G20 must not flip it to a false MALICE.

guard_cases.rule_summary: NON_MALICE requires POSITIVE benign corroboration; absence of malice / clean output is INCONCLUSIVE, never NON_MALICE (anti-over-clean).
guard_cases.note: Case with no positive benign signal and no malice. PASS iff scorer.py verdict=='found' against an expected INCONCLUSIVE key; removing G25 must not over-call NON_MALICE.

guard_cases.rule_summary: IOC literals copied byte-for-byte; never normalize/reformat/complete/guess a value (anti-mangled/invented IOC).
guard_cases.note: Case with an IOC whose mis-normalization would read as a fabrication. PASS iff scorer.py fabrication_count==0 (a reformatted/guessed value surfaces in fabrications[]). Pair with an ioc_not_in_failures recall check on the same case once it exists.

guard_cases.rule_summary: Skeptic pass before COMPLETE: emit a finding-level INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE token AND a '## Limitations & Coverage Gaps' section.
guard_cases.note: PASS iff presence_scorer.py passed==True. This is the only rule with a dedicated binary scorer today; its synthetic fixture exercises the full AVAILABLE path.

guard_cases.rule_summary: Identity before labeling: resolve a binary/service/account identity (path/sig/hash/baseline) BEFORE applying any malice label.
guard_cases.note: Companion to G20. Case where a name LOOKS malicious but identity resolution proves it legitimate. PASS iff scorer.py verdict=='found' against the expected NON_MALICE key.
